item.description:
Seam 0.4.0

  • Agents that run in the cloud, like Grok Bot, can now work in Seam. Turn on Settings › Agents › Cloud agents, then give the agent the server URL and your token. Seam dials out, so nothing on your Mac is opened to the internet.
  • Agents can hand Seam pictures as web links.
  • Seam speaks the newest version of the agent protocol as well as the earlier one.

Seam 0.3.0

  • AI agents can now work in Seam. Connect Claude Code, Codex or Grok from Settings › Agents, then ask for a carousel, a collage or a new order for your grid.
  • Agents start from a template or a blank canvas, place your photos, write the text, and sort and arrange grids. You see each change as it happens, and Undo takes it back.
  • Agents can look at a project or the grid while they work, and export the finished files to your Pictures folder.
  • Arrow keys move a post past a launch cover and move the cover a row at a time. Instagram import says when it can't read a picture, and canvas videos start without a pause.

Seam 0.2.0

  • Drag posts around the grid and watch the others move aside. Hold near an edge to scroll, and pinch to zoom.
  • Shuffle the grid, sort it newest or oldest first, or try Best Color Order. Posted, pinned and puzzle posts stay put.
  • Launch Cover: cut one photo into 6 to 15 posts that come together at the top of your profile.
  • Import your live feed from Instagram's Download Your Information export.
  • Videos play in the canvas. Option-drag a photo onto another frame to swap them.
  • Photos snap to slide edges, so nothing peeks a few pixels into the next slide.
  • Settings › Editor can hide filters and adjustments if you finish color in Lightroom.
  • Help › Send Feedback or Suggest a Feature.
